title: Persist GCP slot semantic state atomically with replay high-water
description: GatewayCoordinator::handle_post_slots durably advances SlotClaimVerifier replay state, but peer_claims and the locally reallocated info.slot_map.owned are memory-only. After restart, the gateway retains a high-water that rejects the same authenticated claim while forgetting the accepted peer ownership and any slots it relinquished, recreating collisions until a peer emits a higher sequence. Persistence errors can similarly consume a claim without committing semantic state. Store replay high-water, peer claims, and local allocation as one restart-safe transaction, and test accepted/lost claims across restart and injected write failures.
